Evidence
The university provides ICT enabled classrooms with smart boards and digital learning tools to enhance the teaching-learning process.
The library has a rich collection of e-resources, including e-journals and e-books accessible through the digital library portal.
The campus provides accommodation for boys in two separate blocks (Block A and Block B) managed by the university.
A dedicated girls' hostel is available within the campus providing safe and secure accommodation.
Implementation of JSSSTU Student Portal and ERP for academic management and student services.
Offers Undergraduate (B.E), Postgraduate (M.Tech, MBA, MCA, M.Sc) and Doctoral programs across various engineering and management disciplines.
Annual tuition fee for B.E via COMEDK is approximately 2.35 Lakhs; Management quota varies by branch up to 4.5L.
Total number of students graduating in minimum stipulated time for the 2023-24 cycle was 1138; projected 1150 for 2025.
Out of 1020 eligible students, 854 students were placed in various companies during the 2023-24 placement drive.
The highest package offered during the recent placement season reached 54.75 LPA by Palo Alto Networks.
Median salary of placed graduates (Amount in Rs.) for UG [4 Years Program(s)]: 720000
No. of students selected for Higher Studies: 142 (UG 4-year programs)
No. of Patents Published: 11, No. of Patents Granted: 0 (Calendar Year 2022)
Admission to UG programs is based on KCET and COMEDK scores; PG through PGCET or GATE.
KCET 2023 Round 1 closing ranks for General Merit: CSE 1745, ISE 2956, ECE 5432.
Based on NIRF 2024 Engineering report: Total Actual Student Strength (All programs) = 4590 (UG) + 1103 (PG) = 5693.
NIRF 2024 Engineering: Female students = 1432 (UG) + 413 (PG) = 1845.
Total number of faculty members listed in the NIRF 2024 Engineering Faculty Details table is 248.
Count of faculty members with Ph.D. qualification in the NIRF 2024 Engineering Faculty Details table is 142.
Average of 'Experience (In Months)' for 248 faculty members is approx 170.4 months, which is 14.2 years.
The campus provides extensive sports facilities including cricket, football, and basketball courts along with a well-equipped gymnasium and indoor sports complex.
Active student clubs include technical societies like IEEE, CSI, and SAE, alongside cultural clubs like LCC and Sahitya.
JSS Science and Technology University (SJCE) is ranked in the 151-200 band in the Engineering category by NIRF 2023.
JSS Science and Technology University is established under the JSS Science and Technology University Act No. 43 of 2013.
Total Ph.D students pursuing doctoral program till 2022-23: Full Time (42) + Part Time (206) = 248.
